fusions.name: Taproot Draw
fusions.desc: Drives a root into the target that deals 8 damage, leaves it 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Bitter Leaf-Fall
fusions.desc: Sheds poisonous leaves in a cone 4 tiles ahead of you. It deals 10 poison damage to every enemy caught in it and leaves each one [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Inner-Bark Poultice
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Tannin Core
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and your poison resistance rises by 12%.
